query:
WITH
    trip AS (
        SELECT
            trip_id
        FROM
            trips
        WHERE
            fiskeridir_vessel_id = (
                SELECT
                    fiskeridir_vessel_id
                FROM
                    all_vessels
                WHERE
                    call_sign = $1
            )
            AND trip_id = $2
    ),
    deleted AS (
        DELETE FROM trip_fuel f USING trip t
        WHERE
            t.trip_id = f.trip_id
    )
UPDATE trips_detailed t
SET
    trip_fuel_liter_used = NULL
FROM
    trip f
WHERE
    t.trip_id = f.trip_id
